subject: Snowline Health — trial environment options and ownership
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Barnes <aisha@snowlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Jun 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Snowline Health — trial environment options and ownership

Hi Aisha — great speaking earlier. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we keep momentum: 

Call recap (2 min):
- Goal: validate a retrieval-assisted triage workflow (doc ingestion -> semantic search -> summarization prompts) against Snowline production-ish data.
- Key constraint: PHI scope — you flagged potential need for VPC and KMS integration if we move beyond sandbox.
- Timeline headline: 3-week hands-on eval starting ~Jun 20 would get you a good signal on latency/cost/quality.

Recommended initial environment options (we can run them in parallel):
1) Hosted sandbox (fastest): Redwood hosted API with tenant-isolated sandbox — no infra setup, basic syslogs, data retention short-term. Good for rapid iteration and prompt/eval tuning.
2) Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity): customer-dedicated pool in our infra. Predictable throughput, better isolation, recommended if you need sustained throughput for load tests.
3) VPC/private deployment: customer VPC + customer-managed KMS/HSM; required if data residency or compliance policy forbids cloud-hosted tenant data. Longer setup (2–4 weeks).

Requested from you:
- Success criteria (short list, 3 items max) so we can build the eval harness. Example: end-to-end latency < 550ms p50 on 512 tokens; top-1 extraction F1 > 0.82 on labeled set; cost per 1k queries < $X.
- Preferred start date for trial and any blackout windows the week of Jun 20–27.
- Who on your side will own the sample data/staging creds (+ consent from security/compliance to use redacted set).

Attachments: trial-scope-template.xlsx (fill the success criteria and dataset notes), redwood-hosting-comparison.pdf (quick pros/cons + rough setup times).

Proposed next step: 30-min kickoff (technical + product) Mon Jun 18 or Tue Jun 19 — pick one and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — I’ll loop Ben and Rishi for infra/setup and eval harness work.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Aisha Barnes <aisha@snowlinehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: contracts@snowlinehealth.com
Date: Thu, 6 Jun 2028 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Snowline Health — trial environment options and ownership

Thanks Vanessa — really useful recap. A few clarifications from our side and the success criteria we care about: 

Constraints / must-haves:
- PHI will be in-scope for a portion of the eval (de-identified patient notes plus some narrow identifiers). Our InfoSec prefers VPC/KMS for any "real" PHI; however, we can start with a heavily redacted hosted sandbox for quick iteration if we sign a short data processing addendum.
- Regulatory: data residency within US only (no EU-hosted nodes).

Success criteria (proposal) — please use these to shape the eval harness:
1) Quality: average extraction F1 >= 0.80 on our 1,200-case labeled set for diagnosis-tagging probes.
2) Latency & availability: p95 latency < 1200ms for 512-token workload; availability >= 99.5% over test window.
3) Cost ceiling: running our test deck (10k queries/day) should not exceed $6k/week in hosting costs (we can be flexible but need an estimate).

Timeline and owners:
- Target kickoff window: Jun 20–23 for initial hosted sandbox onboarding.
- If hosted sandbox looks good by end of week 2, we'll request a VPC proof-of-concept for the remaining week.
- Snowline owners: Aisha Barnes (CTO) — overall, Priya Shah (Lead Data Engineer) — sample data & creds, and Legal (contracts@snowlinehealth.com) for DPA.

Happy to meet Mon Jun 18 at 10am PT for the kickoff — that works for me. I’ll fill the trial-scope-template and return it by EOD Friday.

Best,
Aisha
CTO, Snowline Health
aisha@snowlinehealth.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Barnes <aisha@snowlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, contracts@snowlinehealth.com
Date: Fri, 7 Jun 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Snowline Health — trial environment options and ownership

Perfect — appreciate the clear success criteria. I filled the kickoff slot Mon Jun 18 10:00am PT on the calendar (invite sent). Below is our proposed evaluation plan and ownership matrix we will follow on the call: 

Evaluation plan (3 weeks):
- Week 0 (prep, pre-kickoff): legal DPA routing + sample dataset redaction checklist; Redwood will provide a short test token profile and data schema. Owner: contracts@snowlinehealth.com (Legal), Priya Shah (Snowline), Ben (Redwood SE).
- Week 1 (hosted sandbox): onboard sample data into hosted sandbox, tune prompts, run smoke tests and label-derived metrics. Owner: Ben + Priya. Deliverable: baseline metrics dashboard (quality/latency/cost).
- Week 2 (stress & regression): run 10k/day traffic pattern, evaluate p95/p50 and extraction metrics against labeled set; iterate on quantization/batching settings if needed. Owner: Rishi + Ben. Deliverable: perf report + cost curve.
- Week 3 (optional VPC PoC): if hosted baseline meets quality and security gating, spin up VPC PoC for final validation (KMS integration + audit log sampling). Owner: Ben (infra lead) + Priya (Snowline). Deliverable: VPC checklist + go/no-go recommendation.

Ownership and contacts (Redwood):
- Commercial & kickoff: Vanessa Ortiz (me) — primary contact for cadence and PO/contract questions.
- SE & infra setup: Ben Carter — will provision sandbox, share API keys, and coordinate KMS handoff if needed.
- Eval harness & perf tuning: Rishi Malhotra — will own batching/throughput settings and quality monitoring.

Data/sample needs and timeline:
- We’ll need the redacted/consented sample ndjson by Mon Jun 17 EOD to hit Jun 20 start. If you can’t meet that, we can start with a synthetic set and swap in redacted data later in Week 1.

Quick asks for the kickoff (Mon):
- Priya on the call to confirm dataset schema and access method (S3 presigned or scp).
- Legal on the thread to acknowledge DPA timeline (contracts@snowlinehealth.com).

I attached a short hosting comparison and a trial-scope template for you to fill (thanks for offering to return it by EOD Friday).

See you Mon.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>

Vanessa / Aisha — quick infra notes: 
- We can provision a hosted sandbox instance and seed it with up to 20k documents in <24 hours once I have the sample file and schema.
- For stress runs, I’ll preconfigure a dedicated sandbox node (no live migration needed) to match the 10k/day traffic pattern. That will let Rishi capture accurate p95 numbers.

Request: can Priya send the sample dataset as a redacted ndjson and include an example request/response token profile (avg tokens per query, avg response length)? 

Attachment: sample-dataset-redacted.ndjson (placeholder) — please update with your real file.

—Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben — Priya will send the redacted ndjson by Mon Jun 17 EOD. A couple of follow-ups: 
- Please send a short note on expected pricing delta between hosted sandbox vs dedicated sandbox for the 3-week window (we just need a ballpark to circulate internally).
- If hosted sandbox looks good, how long to switch to VPC PoC? You mentioned 2–4 weeks earlier — we need a tighter number for planning.

Contracts (cc) — any DPA template we should sign before data upload?

Appreciate the quick turn.

—Aisha

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 8 Jun 2028 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Snowline Health — trial environment options and ownership

Aisha — short answers to keep your planning doc moving: 
- Ballpark pricing (3-week trial, E2E test deck at 10k Q/day): hosted sandbox estimate ~$8–10k total (includes incremental per-token & temporary storage). Dedicated sandbox estimate ~$12–18k total depending on reserved capacity size; we’ll provide a precise cost sheet after you confirm expected concurrency and p50/p95 targets. 
- VPC PoC: typical provisioning and KMS integration is 10–14 business days once we have network contacts and KMS material (can be faster with dedicated cloud partner support).
- DPA: contracts@redwoodinference.com will share our standard DPA + a short PHI addendum for sandbox use. Please loop legal.

Next steps I’ll own: send a one-pager cost worksheet and a kickoff agenda by EOD today, confirm calendar invite for Mon Jun 18 10:00am PT. Ben will prepare the sandbox template and an example token profile for Priya. Rishi will prep an eval harness checklist.

If you want a quick pricing call before legal signs anything, happy to have our sales director join next Tue.

—Vanessa
